## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and catalog data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

*Attakāmpāricariya* ("Encouraging a woman to satisfy one’s desires") constitutes the fourth *saṅghādisesa* training rule of the *Bhikkhu Vibhaṅga* within the Pali Vinaya Piṭaka. The rule legislates against sexual solicitation, establishing that a lustful monk who commends the servicing of his own passions to a woman—suggesting or recommending sexual congress—commits an offense requiring formal suspension and community rehabilitation (*saṅghādisesa*). An English translation of the rule and its canonical analysis has been prepared by Bhikkhu Brahmali.
